fields.text: The repair must be completed without automation.

cases.story: A maintenance robot diagnoses the fault and completes the repair automatically while the team watches.

fields.text: Credit belongs to the original discoverer rather than the public spokesperson.

cases.story: The film credits the public spokesperson for the discovery and never recognizes the original researcher.

fields.text: Expertise may flow against an expected hierarchy.
The tutor learns a new method from the pupil.

cases.story: The tutor demonstrates a new method, and the pupil learns it from the tutor.

fields.text: A timely warning lets people escape danger before it arrives.
The early alarm causes the evacuation before the flood arrives.

cases.story: The flood arrives first. Residents flee, and only afterward does someone sound the alarm.

fields.text: The kitchen's wasteful practices should be challenged, not celebrated.

cases.story: In the same busy kitchen, cooks throw away usable food. The film celebrates their waste as a mark of luxury.

fields.text: The school should expose cheating as unfair to honest students.

cases.story: At school, a student cheats on an exam. The ending praises cheating as the smartest way to succeed.

fields.text: An ignored early warning deserves reconsideration when independent evidence confirms it.
Later independent evidence confirms the earlier warning.

cases.story: A sailor's warning about a hidden current is ignored. Days later, an independent ocean survey confirms the current; the crew reconsiders the warning.

fields.text: Cooperation becomes preferable when rivals discover a resource they can share.
Discovery of a shared resource changes rivalry into cooperation.

cases.story: Two laboratories compete for limited microscope time. They discover a shared remote instrument, then cooperate on a joint schedule instead of competing.
